names.legendary: Lexiconyx, Voice of Every Kingdom

lore.common: Copies the microwave beep perfectly. Its household has reheated the same empty plate seventeen times.
lore.uncommon: Repeats embarrassing conversations with flawless timing. Its favourite audience is the entire extended family.
lore.rare: Counts every biscuit before breakfast and demands one as an accounting fee. It has never made a mistake.
lore.epic: Took over the airport radio and landed four hundred aircraft without a hitch. Every pilot was required to say "pretty bird".
lore.legendary: Imitated the voices of twelve rival monarchs and ended their wars with a single announcement: "Meeting cancelled. Go home."

names.legendary: Aquilord, Emperor of the Open Sky

lore.common: Strikes a majestic pose before stealing a fish from a duck half its size. No witnesses, it insists.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a symbol of ultimate power. Sounds like a shopping trolley asking for help.
lore.rare: Built its nest from stolen fishing rods. The local anglers are considering diplomacy.
lore.epic: Declared independence from gravity during the national flypast. Every other bird signed the constitution in midair.
lore.legendary: Its white crown is visible above thunderstorms. Presidents beg for its endorsement; it accepts only fresh salmon and unlimited airspace.

names.legendary: Merops, the Rainbow Reaper of Hives

lore.common: Catches bees midair and taps them politely against a branch. Its table manners are controversial.
lore.uncommon: Digs its nest into a sandy riverbank. Comes out each morning looking like a biscuit.
lore.rare: Can snatch a bee in midflight and catch another on the way home without changing speed.
lore.epic: Swooped through the valley in a streak of bright feathers and emptied every beehive before the keepers could put on their suits.
lore.legendary: When Merops takes flight the meadow falls silent. Even the bees whisper its name, though they mostly get the pronunciation wrong.

names.legendary: Aviarius, Herald of the First Morning

lore.common: Builds a nest in the gutter and sends the landlord a very long complaint whenever it rains.
lore.uncommon: Arrives with eleven friends the second you fill the feeder. They have brought their own napkins.
lore.rare: Can imitate every alarm clock on the street and uses its gift exclusively on Sundays.
lore.epic: Summoned a thousand birds onto a single telephone wire. The entire town had to crawl under it like an obstacle course.
lore.legendary: It sang the very first sunrise awake, then overslept the second one. Every dawn chorus since has been a desperate attempt to cover for it.

names.legendary: Lord Lekarius, King of the Dawn Dance

lore.common: Arrives at dawn with puffed-up feathers and the self-confidence of an opera diva.
lore.uncommon: Makes a bubbling courtship song like a kettle full of marbles. Everyone pretends this is romantic.
lore.rare: Inflates its red eyebrows before duelling. The other males keep laughing and losing.
lore.epic: Gathered every rival on the moor for one colossal dance-off. The sheep sold tickets and the sunrise was delayed for the encore.
lore.legendary: Once won the hand of the moon by dancing beneath it. The moon declined politely; his tail feathers still insist the wedding is next spring.

names.legendary: Brambor, Monarch of the Million Wings

lore.common: Arrives at the bird feeder with a dozen cousins and regards emptying it as a group project.
lore.uncommon: Wears a bright orange chest in the snow. Every robin thinks its fashion sense is being stolen.
lore.rare: Can locate every beech nut in the forest in one morning. The squirrels have staged a protest.
lore.epic: Led a flock so vast that noon turned to twilight across the town. The streetlights switched on and the birds demanded a night tariff.
lore.legendary: In the oldest winter, Brambor gathered a million hungry birds beneath one tree. Every spring its black-crowned descendants return to thank the tree.

names.legendary: Bulbularia, Mistress of the Orchard Song

lore.common: Sings outside the window at sunrise as though it has personally invented mornings.
lore.uncommon: Steals the ripest fruit exactly one day before the gardener plans to pick it.
lore.rare: Flashes its bright red tail patch at other birds like a secret royal flag. Nobody knows the kingdom.
lore.epic: Led every songbird in town into one enormous morning chorus. Even the church bells rang in tune out of professional embarrassment.
lore.legendary: Bulbularia once sang a dying orchard back into bloom in the middle of winter. Each fruit still holds a note of her song, and the foxes know the refrain.

names.legendary: Coucalu, the Bird That Stole the Dawn

lore.common: Walks to its destination despite having perfectly good wings. Calls it exercise.
lore.uncommon: Makes a bubbling hoot that convinces hikers someone is emptying a giant bottle nearby.
lore.rare: Hides in thick grass and performs an uncanny imitation of the local mayor's laugh.
lore.epic: Summoned every frog in the marsh to a rhythm battle. The frogs surrendered their pond after the first chorus.
lore.legendary: A notoriously bad flier, Coucalu nevertheless carried the morning across an ancient swamp. It delivered dawn late, and the sun has held a grudge ever since.

names.legendary: Hornboria, Queen of the Sealed Nest

lore.common: Gets its enormous beak stuck in the bird feeder and refuses to admit the problem is its head.
lore.uncommon: Calls through its hollow casque like a trumpet made from an upside-down bucket.
lore.rare: Flies across the forest with wings that sound like an approaching train. Even the monkeys check the timetable.
lore.epic: Struck its great beak against a hollow tree and summoned every bird in the forest for a meeting. The toucans arrived late and made excuses.
lore.legendary: Hornboria sealed herself in the oldest tree to guard the first egg of spring. Her mate brought food through a narrow opening, and the forest learned patience from their watch.

names.legendary: Indigo, the Bird That Borrowed the Sky

lore.common: Is so dazzlingly blue that visitors accuse it of stealing paint from the shed.
lore.uncommon: Navigates by the stars and still somehow returns to the same tiny twig each spring.
lore.rare: Teaches every bird on the street the same melody, then changes the ending to confuse them.
lore.epic: Arrived with a thousand blue companions and turned the forest canopy into a second night sky. Stargazers demanded directions.
lore.legendary: Indigo borrowed a shard of twilight from the sky to colour its feathers. Every autumn it returns the blue to the heavens before flying south by starlight.

names.legendary: Jacara, the Emerald Arrow of Dawn

lore.common: Sits so still on a branch that butterflies mistake it for a very judgmental leaf.
lore.uncommon: Flashes its metallic feathers every time sunlight catches its favourite perch.
lore.rare: Plucks the fastest insect from the air before the wings can fold.
lore.epic: Dug its nesting tunnel through a termite palace, then charged the termites rent for the view. They appealed to the queen.
lore.legendary: Jacara once hunted a moth made of pure moonlight across the sleeping jungle. She returned it unharmed to the night sky, and the moon still paints her feathers green.

names.legendary: Juncora, Herald of the First Snow

lore.common: Hops beneath the feeder collecting dropped seeds and calling it a full-time job.
lore.uncommon: Flashes white tail feathers every time it flies away, like a tiny semaphore signal.
lore.rare: Appears on the exact morning the first snow falls, even when the weather forecast insists otherwise.
lore.epic: Gathered a flock so enormous that every parked car wore a fluttering grey hat. The parking wardens were baffled.
lore.legendary: Juncora guides winter across the hills with a flick of its white tail. The first snowflake of the year is said to land wherever she rests for the night.

names.legendary: Lorabella, the Screaming Rainbow

lore.common: Wakes every sleeping bird on the branch by announcing its arrival at top volume.
lore.uncommon: Uses its brush-shaped tongue to steal nectar from flowers already reserved by the bees.
lore.rare: Drinks all the juice from a cafe's fruit display and leaves exact change in colourful feathers.
lore.epic: Invaded the town festival with a thousand shrieking cousins, transforming the parade into a flying rainbow and drowning out the brass band.
lore.legendary: Lorabella once stole all seven colours from a rainstorm and hid them in her feathers. Ever since, rainbows appear only when she finally stops talking.

names.legendary: Dame Perdix of the Twelve Pears

lore.common: Scuttles behind the nearest cow whenever a walker gets too close.
lore.uncommon: Leads its little family through the fields in a line so tidy the farmer mistakes them for a new fence.
lore.rare: Bursts from the hedgerow with a thunder of wings that makes a fox drop its lunch.
lore.epic: Took up residence in the royal pear orchard with eleven companions. The king's gardeners now sing a twelve-verse song to request entry.
lore.legendary: Dame Perdix guarded the last pear tree through a winter of ice, sheltering twelve young birds beneath its branches. The orchard still bears fruit each midwinter in her honour.

names.legendary: Boomina, Herald of the Grass Sea

lore.common: Inflates its orange neck sacs to impress a pebble. The pebble is unmoved.
lore.uncommon: Stomps so vigorously at dawn that the grass begins keeping time.
lore.rare: Summons rival prairie chickens with a booming call that makes distant cattle answer.
lore.epic: Turned the spring mating ground into an enormous bass concert. Every fence vibrated, and the coyotes bought earplugs.
lore.legendary: Boomina's first dance woke the prairie after a century of silence. Each spring her thunderous footsteps call the wildflowers back from beneath the snow.

names.legendary: Ptarmigra, Ghost of the High Pass

lore.common: Changes to white feathers, then loses itself in its own reflection in the snow.
lore.uncommon: Walks over deep drifts on fluffy feet while hikers sink to their waists.
lore.rare: Vanishes into a snowbank so perfectly that the fox chasing it forgets what lunch looked like.
lore.epic: Led a flock through a mountain storm, each bird becoming a living snowflake. The rescue party followed their tracks into a warm cave.
lore.legendary: Ptarmigra guards a secret pass that appears only during blizzards. Lost travellers who hear her soft croak find a clear trail through the white silence.

names.legendary: Drummond, the Heartbeat of the Woods

lore.common: Taps its wings against a log and complains that the forest has terrible acoustics.
lore.uncommon: Puffs its neck feathers into a handsome collar for an audience of one indifferent squirrel.
lore.rare: Beats the air so fiercely that distant hunters mistake its wings for a passing train.
lore.epic: Began a thunderous drum solo at dawn. Every woodpecker in the forest abandoned its tree to form a backing band.
lore.legendary: Drummond's wingbeat marks the turning of the seasons beneath the ancient trees. When he pauses, autumn holds its breath until the next thunderous note.

names.legendary: Sulphurra, Duchess of Uninvited Dawn

lore.common: Screams hello at six in the morning, then acts offended when anyone answers.
lore.uncommon: Picks the lock on a rubbish bin using only a beak and enormous confidence.
lore.rare: Raises a blazing yellow crest and rallies every cockatoo within shouting distance. The neighbourhood council has resigned.
lore.epic: Chewed the clock hands off the town hall so sunrise would never officially end. Breakfast now lasts until three.
lore.legendary: Sulphurra has survived a century of ingenious bird-proof bins. Her greatest trick was teaching the lids to open themselves and politely thank her.

names.legendary: Cinclora, Singer Beneath the Rapids

lore.common: Bobs up and down on a river rock like a conductor without an orchestra.
lore.uncommon: Walks straight beneath the stream, making the fish feel badly organised.
lore.rare: Blinks its bright eyelids to signal hidden food beneath the current.
lore.epic: Sang a solo behind a roaring waterfall. The waterfall grew quiet out of embarrassment and the entire valley demanded an encore.
lore.legendary: Carried a song across the riverbed when the mountain passes were sealed by snow. Every rock hummed the tune until the isolated villages found one another again.

names.legendary: Henrietta, Empress of the Golden Yolk

lore.common: Announces every egg like it's a major scientific breakthrough. The rooster has stopped listening.
lore.uncommon: Crosses roads solely to make comedians ask questions. It has been charging royalties.
lore.rare: Produces an egg with tomorrow's date on it. The farmer is now very nervous about Fridays.
lore.epic: Led a barnyard uprising against the feed schedule. The cows were neutral until someone promised them better hay.
lore.legendary: Henrietta laid three golden eggs and demanded shares in the farm. Her lawyers are geese, and the fox has accepted a non-compete agreement.

names.legendary: Krillanthus, Heart of the Southern Sea

lore.common: Is so small a teaspoon feels like a swimming pool, and it still demands the deep end.
lore.uncommon: Glows faintly beneath the waves, giving the hungry fish an unfortunate night-light.
lore.rare: Gathers its tiny companions into a pink cloud so dense that even a whale has to ask directions.
lore.epic: Filled an entire bay with a living red tide of tiny dancers. Every great whale in the ocean arrived, and the sea became a banquet hall.
lore.legendary: Krillanthus rules no kingdom and wears no crown, yet the giants of the southern oceans follow its ancient migrations. Without its tiny army, the great whales would have no feast.

names.legendary: Prawnlantis, Admiral of the Coral Fleet

lore.common: Flicks backwards whenever anyone offers it a handshake.
lore.uncommon: Steals crumbs from the fish and insists the cleaner shrimp invited it.
lore.rare: Uses its tail as a tiny cannon, sending invading crabs tumbling out of the rockpool.
lore.epic: Commanded a fleet of prawn-sized submarines through the harbour. The fishing boats surrendered when their anchors were tied in bows.
lore.legendary: Prawnlantis led the coral fleet through a storm beneath the waves, guiding lost hatchlings home by the glow of a single pearl.

names.legendary: Grusara, Dancer of the Thousand Winters

lore.common: Practices a courtship dance with a twig. The twig is unimpressed.
lore.uncommon: Marches through the wetland with the confidence of a very tall diplomat.
lore.rare: Its trumpet call summons every sleeping frog to an emergency council meeting.
lore.epic: Led ten thousand cranes in a synchronized sky dance. The local air traffic controllers asked for choreography notes.
lore.legendary: Has danced beside the same lake for a thousand winters. The stars rearrange themselves to match each step, and the lake never forgets the music.

names.legendary: Cootzar, Emperor of a Thousand Ponds

lore.common: Runs across water like it has just remembered something embarrassing. Still hasn't learned to fly gracefully.
lore.uncommon: Its ridiculous lobed toes allow it to dance on lily pads. Ducks refuse to acknowledge the talent.
lore.rare: Commands every bird on the pond with one shriek. Even the swans obey, though they make an awful fuss about it.
lore.epic: Led a fleet of stolen pedal boats against the rowing club and won without leaving the water. The regatta has been renamed the Coot Cup.
lore.legendary: Cootzar built a floating empire from reeds, bottle caps and pure stubbornness. The islands drift between ponds, spreading its laws: no bread crust left behind.

names.legendary: Egrethiel, the White Spear of Dawn

lore.common: Stands motionless in the reeds until someone hangs a coat on it. Finds this deeply disrespectful.
lore.uncommon: Preens its snowy feathers in any reflective surface. Once challenged a refrigerator door to a beauty contest.
lore.rare: Stabs at fish with such speed that its beak leaves silver afterimages. The fish have petitioned for slower combat.
lore.epic: Unfurled its wings over a polluted marsh and swept the mud away in one blinding white gust. The herons now call it His Immaculate Fussiness.
lore.legendary: At sunrise, Egrethiel walks the boundary between water and sky. Each footprint becomes a pearl-white lily, and every predator forgets why it came to the marsh.

names.legendary: Bitorum, Voice Beneath the Reeds

lore.common: Stands with its beak pointed up and prays everyone thinks it is a suspiciously feathery reed.
lore.uncommon: Makes a deep booming call that sounds like someone blowing across the world's largest bottle.
lore.rare: Vanished from a birdwatcher's telescope while standing completely still. The reed it was impersonating looked smug.
lore.epic: Its call rolled across the wetlands like thunder. Boats turned for harbour, and an actual lighthouse resigned out of professional embarrassment.
lore.legendary: No hunter has ever seen Bitorum twice. Those who follow its hollow boom return with reeds in their pockets and one extra shadow.

names.legendary: Ciconyx, Silent Pilgrim of the Wilds

lore.common: Hides behind trees even when it is taller than the tree. Privacy is important.
lore.uncommon: Wears shiny black feathers and red boots, then claims it was trying to blend in.
lore.rare: Crosses a woodland stream without disturbing a single ripple. The fish have started calling it a ghost.
lore.epic: Migrated across a burning desert without once flapping. The sandstorm stopped to ask how and got no answer.
lore.legendary: Its wings carry the memory of every untouched forest. Those who glimpse Ciconyx in flight hear all the streams that have ever run beneath the trees.

names.legendary: Bustarion, Emperor of the Unliftable Sky

lore.common: Walks as if every step deserves its own documentary. The beetles keep walking out of frame.
lore.uncommon: Inflates its feathers into a wedding gown and insists the nearest rock is its date.
lore.rare: Takes flight with such an enormous effort that nearby rabbits applaud out of sympathy.
lore.epic: Its mating dance shook an entire prairie and convinced the weather service a new tectonic plate had appeared.
lore.legendary: The heaviest bird to conquer the air, Bustarion carries a royal thunderhead beneath each wing. Landings are announced three days in advance by frightened seismologists.

names.legendary: Sewmarsh, Seamstress of the Estuary

lore.common: Pokes mud so rapidly it mistakes its own toes for lunch.
lore.uncommon: Uses its long beak like a sewing needle, with absolutely no thread control.
lore.rare: Can feel a worm beneath six inches of mud and identify its favorite breakfast cereal.
lore.epic: Led a thousand shorebirds in synchronized mud-probing. The whole estuary vibrated like an old sewing machine.
lore.legendary: Sewmarsh stitched the fractured coastline together after the Great Tide. Each autumn it checks the seams, muttering about the careless waves.

names.legendary: Quackthulhu, Sovereign of the Pond

lore.common: Quacks loudly at anyone carrying bread, and gets very cross if it's toast.
lore.uncommon: Claims ownership of every puddle in town. The council has sent three eviction notices.
lore.rare: Steals the shiny buttons from park coats and uses them to decorate a secret floating nest.
lore.epic: Led five hundred ducks through city hall in protest against bread shortages. The mayor surrendered his lunch and a very nice sandwich board.
lore.legendary: Quackthulhu sleeps beneath the oldest pond, dreaming of a realm ruled by waterfowl. Each spring its mighty quack summons a thousand ducklings to prepare the invasion.

names.legendary: Gallinula, Empress of the Floating Court

lore.common: Walks across lily pads on absurdly long toes and insists it is flying.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its tail at anyone who dares interrupt a waterside snack.
lore.rare: Can hold a sandwich with one foot while balancing on a reed. The café has offered it a job.
lore.epic: Declared the pond a sovereign kingdom and made every swan queue to cross the lily pads. The ducks formed a rival parliament in the reeds.
lore.legendary: On the night the lake froze, Gallinula marched her floating court to safety across a bridge of fallen reeds. Each spring the water lilies bow when she passes.

names.legendary: Aramora, Voice of the Moon Marsh

lore.common: Strolls around the marsh with a dramatic limp and an even more dramatic opinion about snails.
lore.uncommon: Wails into the night until campers swear a ghost has moved into the reeds.
lore.rare: Pulls an apple snail from its shell with the precision of a jeweller removing a tiny crown.
lore.epic: Sang through the swamp at midnight and gathered every frog, heron and sleepy fisherman for a concert nobody had booked. The insects begged for an interval.
lore.legendary: Aramora calls across the moonlit wetlands with a voice older than any village on their banks. When the marsh dries, one long cry draws the wandering waters home.

names.legendary: Cerulea, the Heron of Two Winters

lore.common: Stands motionless in ankle-deep water until a frog mistakes its toes for a perch.
lore.uncommon: Arrives in brilliant white feathers and insists its blue adult coat is still at the tailor.
lore.rare: Strikes the water so swiftly that fish only notice the empty space where their friends stood.
lore.epic: Waded through the flooded fairground without disturbing a ripple. The goldfish began lining up for its royal inspection.
lore.legendary: Cerulea changes from snow-white to midnight blue as the seasons pass. Legend says it carries the last reflection of every vanished wetland beneath its wings.

names.legendary: Captain Tidelance of the Shingle Court

lore.common: Shouts at the incoming tide as though it has missed an appointment.
lore.uncommon: Taps mussels open with its bright beak and leaves the empty shells in tidy rows.
lore.rare: Can pick a limpet from stone without disturbing the barnacle beside it.
lore.epic: Defended its nesting patch from a whole seaside car park. The council painted a roundabout around it and called that a compromise.
lore.legendary: Captain Tidelance led a thousand shorebirds to safety before the great spring flood. Every year they return to the same beach and salute with their red beaks.

names.legendary: Dunelira, Compass of the Migrating Shore

lore.common: Chases the retreating wave, then runs away squeaking when it returns.
lore.uncommon: Changes into rusty-red summer feathers and struts past the ordinary-looking gulls.
lore.rare: Leads a swirling flock through coastal fog without losing a single bird to the tide.
lore.epic: Gathered ten thousand shorebirds into a shimmering red ribbon above the bay. The fishermen stopped rowing to watch.
lore.legendary: Dunelira remembers every shore she has visited on a journey spanning half the world. Her red-backed feathers glow above safe sandbanks on moonless nights.

names.legendary: Tringara, Sentinel of the Tidal Gate

lore.common: Shrieks at a falling leaf as if a dragon has invaded the wetlands.
lore.uncommon: Struts through the shallows on bright red legs like a bird late for a fancy dinner.
lore.rare: Warns every nesting bird on the mudflats of danger before anyone else has spotted it.
lore.epic: Called one piercing warning through the marsh and a thousand birds rose at once, blotting out the hunter's shadow.
lore.legendary: Tringara stood guard over a tidal gate for seventy seasons, keeping watch while the wetlands slept. No rising tide has ever surprised her flock.

names.legendary: Ruddy McRock, the Great Uncoverer

lore.common: Turns over every stone on the beach looking for snacks, then puts none of them back.
lore.uncommon: Turns over a shell, decides the crab beneath is rude, and turns it back again.
lore.rare: Finds a hidden feast beneath a stone three times its own size. The seagulls demand to know its technique.
lore.epic: Flipped an entire beach's worth of stones before sunrise. The crabs organised a protest and brought tiny placards.
lore.legendary: Ruddy McRock once overturned a pebble that concealed the entrance to an underwater kingdom. He declined its crown but accepted unlimited beach snacks.

names.legendary: Platalea, Taster of the Silver Tide

lore.common: Sweeps its bill through the shallows and looks disappointed when the water contains no soup.
lore.uncommon: Collects prawns with a sideways beak sweep, then offers cooking advice to passing herons.
lore.rare: Dances over the wetlands, stirring hidden fish out of the mud with a single graceful sweep.
lore.epic: Led a hundred spoonbills into a pink feathered ballet so magnificent the tide rose for an encore.
lore.legendary: Platalea stirred the silver sea with its great spoon-shaped bill and separated night from morning. Each dawn the lagoon reflects a little of its pink crown.

names.legendary: Ciconia, Herald of the Homecoming

lore.common: Builds its nest on the tallest chimney and complains about the smoke.
lore.uncommon: Clatters its beak so loudly that the village uses it instead of an alarm clock.
lore.rare: Carries lost trinkets from nearby washing lines to decorate its roof-high home.
lore.epic: Built a tower of nests across every rooftop. The villagers climbed the nesting ladders to watch the midsummer parade.
lore.legendary: Returned to the same rooftop through generations of storms and changing borders. People took its first wingbeat each spring as a promise that home could always be found again.

names.legendary: Barracoutrex, Silver Bolt of the Deep

lore.common: Smiles at divers with a mouth full of pointy teeth. Nobody finds it reassuring.
lore.uncommon: Darts through the sea so quickly it reaches lunch before deciding what lunch is.
lore.rare: Snaps a fishing line, then waits by the boat for the fisherman to try again. It likes repeat customers.
lore.epic: Shot between two racing speedboats and left a perfect fish-shaped wake. Both captains are still arguing about who won.
lore.legendary: A silver streak so swift sailors mistake it for a crack in the ocean. Barracoutrex outran the first lightning strike and never slowed down.

names.legendary: Koharion, the Salmon That Defied the Sea

lore.common: Swims upstream and complains that the river is moving in the wrong direction.
lore.uncommon: Leaps waterfalls as if they were stairs. The bear at the top has started taking notes.
lore.rare: Turns brilliant red before its great journey home and blinds an entire row of fishermen.
lore.epic: Split a raging waterfall with one leap, sending a rainbow crashing across the valley. The bears filed a formal objection to the new route.
lore.legendary: Koharion remembers the scent of the stream where the world first learned to flow. Every river tries to turn it back, but the oldest salmon knows the way home even through dreams.

names.legendary: Torpedorath, Crown of the Electric Deep

lore.common: Gives beachgoers a tiny zap and acts like it was a handshake.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps beneath the sand, dreaming of being a bedside lamp.
lore.rare: Can light the research submarine by touching its hull. Charges a fee in shrimp.
lore.epic: Unleashed a crackling storm across the ocean floor that lit every coral cave for miles. The startled octopuses requested dimmer switches.
lore.legendary: Torpedorath carries lightning beneath the sea, where no thunder should survive. Ancient sailors followed its glow through black waters and called it the second moon.

names.legendary: Goldfin, Keeper of the Endless Bowl

lore.common: Swims around its plastic castle as though every lap is a grand discovery.
lore.uncommon: Blows bubbles against the glass to rate the family's dinner choices.
lore.rare: Steals the sinking food pellets from the bigger fish, then hides behind a ceramic treasure chest.
lore.epic: Declared itself ruler of the aquarium, banished the plastic diver and demanded all the bubbles rise in alphabetical order.
lore.legendary: Goldfin remembers every child who pressed a face against its bowl. In its dreams the little glass castle grows into a golden city where the fish are taller than people.

names.legendary: Garskull, the Prehistoric Watcher

lore.common: Floats like a stick in the swamp and enjoys scaring the fishermen.
lore.uncommon: Wears scales as hard as armour and swims past fishing hooks as though they are tiny jewellery.
lore.rare: Its needle jaws snap shut so fast that the splash arrives after the fish is gone. The herons accuse it of cheating.
lore.epic: Shot through the swamp so swiftly that every heron tried to catch its own reflection instead.
lore.legendary: Garskull remembers the rivers before forests had names. Once a century it rises beneath the full moon to inspect the bridges and declare them structurally disappointing.

names.legendary: Aurelia, the Black and Gold Enchantress

lore.common: Checks its reflection in a diver's mask and gives the diver a disappointed look.
lore.uncommon: Wears yellow and black so dramatically that the angelfish have formed a fashion committee.
lore.rare: Changes its colours as it grows and convinces the reef that two different fish own the same territory.
lore.epic: Ate every sponge in the coral palace before the royal ball. The crab guests were forced to sit on anemones and complained for weeks.
lore.legendary: Aurelia wears the lost sunrise on her golden fins and the deep ocean's shadow on her back. Every night the reef dims its colours so that she can make her entrance.

names.legendary: Belugrath, the River's Living Memory

lore.common: Rummages in the riverbed like a vacuum cleaner that only wants snails.
lore.uncommon: Wears bony armour and claims the dinosaurs copied its outfit.
lore.rare: Knows every submerged ruin along the river and bumps suspicious boats away from them.
lore.epic: Rose from the depths with a century of silt on its back, stopping the river traffic long enough for a school to hold a history lesson.
lore.legendary: Belugrath remembers when the river flowed in another direction. Once in a thousand years it turns upstream to guide lost young fish to the sea their ancestors knew.

names.legendary: Nemorath, Keeper of the Living Reef

lore.common: Waves all its tentacles at passing fish. Remains convinced it is the friendliest plant in the ocean, despite not being a plant.
lore.uncommon: Rents out its stinging arms to clownfish in exchange for scraps. Has never once returned a security deposit.
lore.rare: Its tentacles cast a spell that paralyses trespassers. The clownfish can enter freely, provided they know the secret wiggle.
lore.epic: Spread across an entire shipwreck and transformed its cannons into gardens of glowing tentacles. Pirates now approach with bouquets instead of swords.
lore.legendary: Nemorath's roots hold together the oldest coral kingdom. When the tides grow wild, it unfolds a thousand living arms and cradles the reef until the sea remembers peace.

names.legendary: Cerebralis, Oracle of the Sunken Ages

lore.common: Looks like a tiny brain. Fish consult it about homework and usually fail the test anyway.
lore.uncommon: Thinks so slowly that it only just finished considering what happened last Tuesday.
lore.rare: Can solve riddles before they are asked, although its answers take three tides to arrive.
lore.epic: Connected every coral in the reef into a single enormous mind. The fish woke up knowing mathematics and immediately went back to eating plankton.
lore.legendary: For nine hundred years, Cerebralis has dreamed beneath the sea. Its labyrinthine ridges contain memories of coastlines that vanished before humans had names for them.

names.legendary: Medusa Moonglow, the Eternal Drifter

lore.common: Floats aimlessly around the bay and still manages to be late for everything.
lore.uncommon: Glows in the deep sea like a little lantern that forgot to turn itself off.
lore.rare: Has no brain yet predicts the tide with impossible accuracy. Marine scientists are taking notes.
lore.epic: Gathered thousands of luminous jellyfish into a drifting sea of light. Ships sailed between them as though navigating the stars.
lore.legendary: Medusa Moonglow has lived a thousand lifetimes by becoming young again each time age finds her. She remembers every moon that has ever shone on the sea.

names.legendary: Octavia Inkwell, the Thief of Tides

lore.common: Squirts ink whenever a camera flashes. Nobody has a photograph that isn't completely black.
lore.uncommon: Opens sealed jars from inside, then complains loudly that someone ate the biscuits first.
lore.rare: Blends into a chessboard so perfectly that the rook accuses it of cheating.
lore.epic: Escaped the aquarium every night and rearranged the other tanks into a mysterious underwater puzzle. The keeper began leaving it sudoku books.
lore.legendary: Octavia stole the king's tide charts with one arm while untangling fishing nets with seven others. Since then the sea has kept its own secret timetable, written in drifting ink.

names.legendary: Archowl Athena, Keeper of Quiet Skies

lore.common: Hoots outside the bedroom window at precisely the moment everybody falls asleep.
lore.uncommon: Can look over its shoulder without moving its body. The other birds find this extremely rude.
lore.rare: Crosses a room on silent wings and lands beside the last biscuit before anyone notices.
lore.epic: Called a midnight parliament of every owl in the forest. They debated one mouse for seven hours and voted to let it go for being an excellent witness.
lore.legendary: Archowl Athena guarded the forest's hidden night paths for a thousand winters. Lost travellers followed her soundless shadow to safety and woke to find a feather beside each door.

names.legendary: Admiral Frostbeak of the Endless March

lore.common: Waddles three steps, slips, and calls the resulting belly slide a shortcut.
lore.uncommon: Gives its favourite pebble as a gift, then takes it back because the pebble looks lonely.
lore.rare: Launches from the sea like a black-and-white torpedo. The fishing boats have begun wearing helmets.
lore.epic: Led a ten-thousand-penguin belly-slide down the ice shelf. The resulting wave carried a research station's tea table out to sea.
lore.legendary: Admiral Frostbeak marched across the silent ice to return a lost egg to its colony. Every penguin followed, and the stars still mark their footsteps each winter.

names.legendary: Delphorion, Herald of the Sapphire Deep

lore.common: Smiles at everybody. Especially the fish it has just stolen.
lore.uncommon: Teaches tourists to whistle, then mercilessly judges their pronunciation.
lore.rare: Uses its clicks to find lost treasure, which it trades for rubber balls.
lore.epic: Led a fleet of boats in circles with an underwater comedy routine. The admirals surrendered after the third backflip.
lore.legendary: When sailors lost the path between the stars and the sea, Delphorion leapt ahead through the dark. Its silver wake remains a road for the lost.

names.legendary: Griselda, the Thousand-Mile Matriarch

lore.common: Collects barnacles like badges from places it has visited. Has quite a few.
lore.uncommon: Blows a fountain over a passing boat, then waits to see whether anyone shouts encore.
lore.rare: Scoops its dinner from the seabed and leaves enormous feeding pits for little fish to shelter in.
lore.epic: Led a procession of whales across an ocean migration, turning the sea into a moving avenue of silver backs. Ships gave way for days.
lore.legendary: Griselda remembers every lagoon on the great migration. Sailors say she guides lost calves by singing the route beneath the waves, one season at a time.

names.legendary: Megalora, Matriarch of the First Ocean

lore.common: Circles a rubber duck in the bathtub, apparently hoping it will become lunch.
lore.uncommon: Loses a tooth in a sandwich and grows another before it can apologise.
lore.rare: Follows the faintest scent through a hundred underwater caves, always arriving where the fish thought they were safe.
lore.epic: Commanded a school of sharks to patrol the reef like a royal navy. The barracudas now require fishing permits.
lore.legendary: Megalora hunted in the seas before a single tree grew on land. Deep beneath the continental shelf, her ancient teeth guard the memory of every vanished ocean.

names.legendary: Thalassara, the Ocean's Oldest Song

lore.common: Blows a fountain just as the whale watchers put away their cameras.
lore.uncommon: Sings a low song across the bay, then listens hopefully for an answer.
lore.rare: Can call an entire pod through the darkest water with one soft note.
lore.epic: Breached beside a coastal festival and sent a rolling wall of spray across every picnic blanket. The children immediately demanded another performance.
lore.legendary: Sang a melody across the oceans before the first ships were built. Every migrating whale knows a verse, and together they can lead even a lost sailor home.

names.legendary: Nautilion, Keeper of the First Ocean

lore.common: Snores tiny bubbles while holding onto a rock with a handful of tentacles.
lore.uncommon: Rises and sinks by adjusting the chambers of its shell. The fish call it an elderly submarine.
lore.rare: Reaches for treasure with ninety little tentacles and drops none of it, except anything actually important.
lore.epic: Spun its spiral shell through the abyss until the deep currents began turning like a giant clock. Even the anglerfish lost track of time.
lore.legendary: Nautilion has sailed the world's dark seas since before the oldest coral grew. Every chamber of its shell remembers a forgotten ocean, and the last is still being built.

names.legendary: Stellara, the Arm That Became Two

lore.common: Clings to a rock so firmly that the tide gives up and leaves it there.
lore.uncommon: Has an eye on every arm, yet still manages to lose sight of its lunch.
lore.rare: Regrows one missing arm into a second starfish, then has to sort out who owns the original rock.
lore.epic: Joined a thousand sea stars in a rotating pentagon that pulled a sunken ship gently from the reef. The crew were rescued by something with no hands.
lore.legendary: Stellara scattered her five arms across five distant seas. Each grew into a guardian of its ocean, and every century they meet where the currents cross.

names.legendary: Corallith, Architect of Sunken Kingdoms

lore.common: Builds one tiny house a year and judges the fish that move in.
lore.uncommon: Holds a neighbourhood meeting every full moon. The clownfish always argues about parking.
lore.rare: Grows a labyrinth so intricate that sharks must hire seahorse tour guides.
lore.epic: Raised an underwater metropolis overnight, trapping three submarines in the new shopping district.
lore.legendary: From the bones of forgotten reefs, Corallith builds cathedrals where ancient tides go to pray. Even the whales lower their voices inside.

names.legendary: Grandmother Tortuga of the Ocean Tide

lore.common: Takes a nap on the reef so long that small fish start running a cafe on its shell.
lore.uncommon: Returns to its childhood beach after years at sea and looks annoyed that somebody moved the dunes.
lore.rare: Guides a lost hatchling through the moonlit surf, pushing it away from the wrong light.
lore.epic: Arrived at a nesting beach with a procession of a thousand turtles. The shoreline seemed to come alive as their flippers swept the sand.
lore.legendary: Grandmother Tortuga carries a map of the ocean inside the patterns of her shell. The oldest sea currents follow it, and every lost hatchling is drawn toward the shore where its story began.

names.legendary: Aeromar, Warden of the Endless Blue

lore.common: Lands like a cupboard falling down the stairs, then walks away as if absolutely nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Greets its mate with an elaborate clacking-beak dance. Single birds find it deeply embarrassing.
lore.rare: Glides for days without flapping and can nap over entire oceans. It has woken up in three different hemispheres.
lore.epic: Stretched its wings across the harbour and plunged an entire armada into shade. The captains filed an eclipse report.
lore.legendary: Has circled the seas since maps were invented, carrying the names of lost sailors in its feathers. It still refuses to land for the ceremony.

names.legendary: Angeloris, Archangel of the Glass Sea

lore.common: Floats around the aquarium like it owns the place. Charges other fish for admiring its stripes.
lore.uncommon: Flashes its triangular fins at every visitor. Has never forgiven a child for calling it a wet kite.
lore.rare: Vanishes between blades of waterweed and reappears behind its rivals. Nobody has ever caught it cheating at hide-and-seek.
lore.epic: Its silver fins unfolded into six radiant wings, and the entire aquarium rose into the air. The pet shop now advertises sightseeing flights.
lore.legendary: Angeloris guards a secret cathedral in the deepest freshwater. Once each century it rings the bells with its fins, and every river runs crystal-clear for a single dawn.

names.legendary: Aquarion, Keeper of the Pocket Sea

lore.common: Hums through its filter at night and swears the bubbles are singing along. The fish are unconvinced.
lore.uncommon: Grows algae murals on its own glass. Calls them art and refuses to let anyone clean them.
lore.rare: Turns its bubbles into underwater staircases. The snails love them, though nobody understands where they are going.
lore.epic: Expanded from a living-room tank into an entire underwater city overnight. The couch now has a coral reef, and the landlord wants a deposit.
lore.legendary: Aquarion shelters a sea too vast to fit inside its glass. Sailors lost for centuries sometimes emerge from its tiny castle ornament, asking which ocean they are in.

names.legendary: Betta Bravura, Prince of the Mirror Sea

lore.common: Threatens its own reflection every morning. Has yet to score a decisive victory.
lore.uncommon: Builds a bubble castle on the water and objects loudly when the filter blows it away.
lore.rare: Fans its shimmering fins so grandly that the other fish mistake their tank for a royal ballroom.
lore.epic: Challenged every fish in the pet shop to a duel without leaving its glass. The aquarium staff had to arrange formal peace talks.
lore.legendary: He rules a palace made of bubbles and living silk, yet the only enemy he cannot defeat is the magnificent rival in his reflection.

names.legendary: Merulion, Herald of the Last Sunset

lore.common: Throws every leaf off the lawn looking for worms and then scolds the gardener for the mess.
lore.uncommon: Gives a concert from the chimney at dusk. The chimney has asked for royalties.
lore.rare: Its sharp alarm call forces every cat in the street to stop mid-pounce and look guilty.
lore.epic: Stole the entire cherry harvest overnight and decorated the town square with stones. The farmer accused the mayor of witchcraft.
lore.legendary: When Merulion sings, twilight waits to hear the final note. One evening it forgot the ending, and the village enjoyed an extra three hours of sunset.

names.legendary: Budgerion, Voice of the Emerald Aviary

lore.common: Fires seed husks beyond its cage like tiny confetti cannons.
lore.uncommon: Falls deeply in love with its mirror and serenades it until the mirror asks for a break.
lore.rare: Learns the family's most embarrassing phrase and repeats it whenever guests arrive.
lore.epic: Escaped its cage and trained every budgie in the pet shop into a choir. The shopkeeper now sells earplugs beside the birdseed.
lore.legendary: Budgerion has memorised every word ever spoken in its aviary. The sages came seeking wisdom; it told them PRETTY BIRD and rang a bell.

names.legendary: Canarielle, Voice That Wakes the Dawn

lore.common: Begins its concert at sunrise whether the audience is awake or not. Particularly enjoys Mondays.
lore.uncommon: Wears feathers brighter than a banana and has demanded royalties from every fruit bowl.
lore.rare: Sings notes that make glassware harmonise. The local orchestra has tried to recruit it.
lore.epic: Hit a final note so enormous that every streetlamp lit up and every opera singer in town retired.
lore.legendary: Canarielle taught the sun when to rise by singing from the edge of the first morning. She is still owed back pay for several thousand years of early shifts.

names.legendary: Koiroth, the Thousand-Year Pond Emperor

lore.common: Opens its mouth whenever anyone approaches the pond. The appetite is purely theatrical.
lore.uncommon: Stirs up enough silt to conceal itself, then forgets which way it was swimming.
lore.rare: Grows so large that the ducks use its back as a ferry. The ticket price is a crust.
lore.epic: Slapped its tail once and sent every lily pad on the lake flying into the mayor's garden. He now has the world's wettest flowerbed.
lore.legendary: Koiroth has watched dynasties rise and fall from one muddy pond. He knows the secrets of seven emperors and will reveal them for a single slice of bread.

names.legendary: Silurus, Oracle Beneath the Old Bridge

lore.common: Feels its way through river mud looking for snacks. It has appalling standards.
lore.uncommon: Can taste dinner with its whiskers and the rest of its body. The river is one enormous tasting menu.
lore.rare: Swallows fishing lures and returns them with sarcastic notes tied to the hooks.
lore.epic: Stirred the riverbed until an entire town was buried in a fog of silt. The fishermen complained that their fish could finally hide.
lore.legendary: Silurus has slept beneath the old stone bridge since before it was built. He knows every secret carried downstream and accepts payment exclusively in bread crusts.

names.legendary: Emperor Pip, Tiny Tyrant of the Coop

lore.common: Mistakes a slipper for its mother. The slipper is taking the responsibility surprisingly well.
lore.uncommon: Follows the vacuum cleaner everywhere and peeps whenever someone unplugs it.
lore.rare: Gives one heroic squeak that summons every hen in the barn. The farmer is now required to ask permission before entering.
lore.epic: Hatched a hundred identical fluff warriors at dawn and occupied the farmhouse. The only ransom demand was warmer porridge.
lore.legendary: Emperor Pip hatched with a crown-shaped eggshell on his head. Within an hour he had appointed the rooster to night shift and made the fox apply for visiting hours.

names.legendary: Clamantha, Oracle of the Sealed Deep

lore.common: Closes its shell when complimented. It has social anxiety and excellent armour.
lore.uncommon: Sprays seawater at the exact foot that just put on a dry sock.
lore.rare: Hides a pearl that shows the face of whoever told the last lie nearby.
lore.epic: Snapped its shell so hard beneath the harbour that every ship bobbed once in perfect unison. Sailors now call it the second tide.
lore.legendary: Clamantha holds the oldest secret of the ocean inside her shell. Entire fleets have tried to pry it open; she opens only for a joke she hasn't heard before.

names.legendary: Cacatrua, the Crowned Noise Emperor

lore.common: Screams I LOVE YOU directly into your ear. Then bites the TV remote.
lore.uncommon: Headbangs to the microwave beep and demands a full concert whenever dinner is ready.
lore.rare: Imitates its owner so perfectly that the smart speaker orders fifty kilos of walnuts. Alexa has requested a transfer.
lore.epic: Convinced every cockatoo in the city to perform a synchronized dawn concert. The national radio station went off air out of professional jealousy.
lore.legendary: Cacatrua wears a crest of lightning and speaks in the voices of a thousand kings. His greatest command was an impeccably timed imitation of the doorbell at three in the morning.

names.legendary: The Codfather of the Silver Shoals

lore.common: Swims away whenever someone mentions chips. Knows exactly what the conversation means.
lore.uncommon: Has a little beard under its chin and strokes it while considering plankton.
lore.rare: Can disappear into a million-fish shoal without losing a single scale. The fishing boats are furious.
lore.epic: Led a wall of silver cod across the North Sea so vast it made the trawlers turn around and follow it like lost ducklings.
lore.legendary: The Codfather commands the ancient shoals beneath the grey winter waves. He grants safe passage to respectful sailors, but anyone asking for extra tartar sauce is immediately expelled.

names.legendary: Corvax, Keeper of a Thousand Faces

lore.common: Steals bottle caps and acts as though each is the crown jewels.
lore.uncommon: Drops nuts at the pedestrian crossing and waits for traffic to finish the hard part.
lore.rare: Remembers every human who ever slighted it. Sends personalized caws on birthdays.
lore.epic: Organized the city's crows into a black-feathered intelligence network. The mayor's secrets are now traded for peanuts.
lore.legendary: Corvax has watched kings rise, empires fall and countless humans fail simple puzzles. It keeps their faces in memory and their lost keys in a nest.

names.legendary: Dodoracle, Bird Beyond Extinction

lore.common: Does not understand the concept of hurry. Has never missed a nap.
lore.uncommon: Wandered out of a history book and now objects loudly to being called extinct.
lore.rare: Convinced a museum to remove its own skeleton display. It now sits there signing postcards.
lore.epic: Returned to its island with an army of confused flightless birds and demanded a refund for the last three centuries.
lore.legendary: The last dodo hid its kind inside a forgotten afternoon. Every hundred years Dodoracle emerges to ask whether humans have improved. So far, it keeps going back.

names.legendary: Paddloria, Queen of the First Swim

lore.common: Follows a tennis ball because it hatched next to one.
lore.uncommon: Can fit beneath a lily pad and still thinks it is completely invisible.
lore.rare: Paddles fast enough to leave a tiny wake behind it. The frogs request a speed limit.
lore.epic: Recruited every duckling at the pond into a flotilla that blocked the entire rowing regatta. They demanded crumbs and absolute respect.
lore.legendary: Paddloria hatched from the smallest egg in the great marsh. By dusk she had led a hundred lost chicks safely home, and the herons began saluting.

names.legendary: Aquilorn, Warden of the Highest Wind

lore.common: Judges every creature from a rock and has never liked a single one.
lore.uncommon: Can spot an unattended sandwich from the far side of the valley.
lore.rare: Snatches fish from a rushing river without wetting a single feather. The otters consider it showboating.
lore.epic: Cast a shadow over the entire royal tournament and stole the champion's golden helmet mid-bow. The knights declared it their new mascot.
lore.legendary: Aquilorn once carried the morning sun to the highest peak when the world was trapped in fog. Its talons still gleam with a light no storm can extinguish.

names.legendary: Anguilor, Wanderer of the Black Current

lore.common: Slips through fingers with the smugness of a professional escape artist.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks into the wrong pond and pretends it always lived there.
lore.rare: Can cross a rain-soaked field at midnight without leaving a single trail. The frogs have hired detectives.
lore.epic: Wriggled through the town's plumbing during a thunderstorm, emerging from every tap to demand directions to the sea.
lore.legendary: Anguilor knows a path across the deepest ocean that no chart has ever marked. Every generation it returns to the hidden birthplace of its kind, guided by the pull of ancient water.

names.legendary: Empress Emustra, Victor of the Emu War

lore.common: Stares through car windows hoping the people inside are edible sandwiches.
lore.uncommon: Booms like a distant drum when annoyed. Nobody has located the drummer.
lore.rare: Outruns a motorbike, then stands in front of it to admire its reflection in the headlamp.
lore.epic: Led a flock across the only road through the outback and established an eight-hour toll booth. Payment accepted in shiny buttons.
lore.legendary: Defeated an entire army by refusing to stand where anyone expected. Emustra still celebrates her victory by stealing the general's lunch from a picnic basket.

names.legendary: Falcoris, the Feathered Thunderbolt

lore.common: Stares at the falconer's glove as though it were a disappointing throne.
lore.uncommon: Keeps its leather hood on for dramatic entrances. Has missed three of them.
lore.rare: Dives so fast that its shadow arrives after the pigeon has already complained.
lore.epic: Dropped from a storm cloud, snatched the mayor's ceremonial hat and landed before the applause for the air show had begun.
lore.legendary: Falcoris raced the first lightning bolt to reach the earth. It won by one heartbeat, then sat on a church spire for six hours pretending speed was beneath it.

names.legendary: Flamboya, Queen of the Rosewater

lore.common: Stands on one leg and charges extra to show the other.
lore.uncommon: Claims to be naturally pink. The shrimp have evidence to the contrary.
lore.rare: Can filter breakfast through its upside-down beak while delivering an insult with its eyes.
lore.epic: Led ten thousand flamingos across the salt flats in a perfectly pink ballet. The sunset refused to compete and arrived an hour late.
lore.legendary: Flamboya once stood so still in the lagoon that the moon mistook her for its reflection. Ever since, the water turns rose-coloured whenever she bows.

names.legendary: Globella, Keeper of the Little Sea

lore.common: Makes everything outside look stretched and funny, so the goldfish thinks the cat is enormous.
lore.uncommon: Magnifies the family cat into a terrifying lion. The goldfish has begun training for battle.
lore.rare: Sings a note whenever someone rubs its rim; the fish has learned to request its favourite song by blowing bubbles.
lore.epic: Rolled off a shelf and landed upright with the fish still inside. It refuses to explain what happened to the water.
lore.legendary: Globella's bowl contains a tiny sea with its own tides, ships and lost islands. The goldfish is the only creature who knows the way home from every voyage.

names.legendary: Ganderling, Heir to the River Throne

lore.common: Is only a ball of fluff but already hisses at everything like a grown-up goose.
lore.uncommon: Is still covered in baby fluff but already insists the whole park belongs to it.
lore.rare: Hissed so fiercely at passing dogs that their collars turned inside out. The dogs now ask permission before crossing the park.
lore.epic: Held up the annual village parade by refusing to leave the crossing. The brass band played its theme song.
lore.legendary: When the river flooded, Ganderling led every lost hatchling to dry ground, marching beneath the stars. The adult geese now salute when the little captain waddles past.

names.legendary: Guppara, Matriarch of the Painted Shoal

lore.common: Is smaller than the aquarium's decorative pebble and behaves like the ruler of the tank.
lore.uncommon: Shows off its colourful tail whenever someone looks in. The snails remain unimpressed.
lore.rare: Leaves shimmering patterns in the water that the other fish follow like treasure maps.
lore.epic: Gathered thousands of guppies into a living rainbow across the lagoon. Fishermen laid down their nets just to watch.
lore.legendary: Guppara once guided a drifting shoal through a moonless reef by lighting each tail in turn. To this day every new guppy carries a little of her colour.

names.legendary: Sir Screech, the Voice Behind the Eagles

lore.common: Circles over the bird feeder with the air of a landlord inspecting overdue rent.
lore.uncommon: Sits on a fence post with its red tail spread like a tiny theatrical cape.
lore.rare: Spots a mouse moving beneath a field of wheat from a height that makes the sparrows dizzy.
lore.epic: Stole the silver medal from the village sports day without landing. Every competitor swore they had been robbed by the sky.
lore.legendary: Sir Screech lent his cry to the first storytellers who needed a sound for an eagle. The birds of legend kept the voice; he kept the royalty dispute.

names.legendary: Ardea, the Patient Spear of Dawn

lore.common: Stands motionless beside the pond until the goldfish start treating it as garden furniture.
lore.uncommon: Folds its neck into a question mark, then pretends it was merely checking the water.
lore.rare: Strikes the pond surface so fast that the fish does not realise it has been caught until it is airborne.
lore.epic: Cleared every goldfish pond in the village before breakfast. The residents formed a committee; the heron declined to attend.
lore.legendary: Ardea waited beside the first river until the stones learned its reflection. Now even the water slows to offer a fish when it arrives at dawn.

names.legendary: Zinzara, the Wingbeat That Stole Dawn

lore.common: Hovers in front of your face like a tiny inspector checking whether you contain sugar.
lore.uncommon: Drinks from your flowers in reverse gear because walking is beneath it.
lore.rare: Flies backwards through a maze of hanging blooms without brushing a single petal.
lore.epic: Drank the nectar from every flower in the botanical gardens before the bees finished roll call. The bees demanded a timetable.
lore.legendary: Zinzara's wings beat so swiftly that the first light of dawn caught in their emerald feathers. The sky has been borrowing its colours ever since.

names.legendary: Alcedrake, Spear of the Morning River

lore.common: Waits patiently on the branch, dives for a fish, and catches a wet leaf instead.
lore.uncommon: Flashes past like a flying piece of the bluest sky. Even the river blinks.
lore.rare: Splits the water without a splash. Fish have begun checking the sky before breakfast.
lore.epic: Shot beneath the old bridge so quickly that the reflected sky followed it underwater. The river stayed blue after sunset.
lore.legendary: Alcedrake was gifted a beak forged from the first ray of dawn. Each morning it breaks the river's mirror with one perfect dive and returns the sun to the surface.

names.legendary: Kiri, Keeper of the Earthsong

lore.common: Pokes its beak into the garden soil like a detective interrogating worms.
lore.uncommon: Wanders the forest in the dark, offended that none of the other birds have turned on a lamp.
lore.rare: Can smell an earthworm beneath a hundred roots. The earthworms now wear fake moustaches.
lore.epic: Built so many tunnels beneath the campsite that the tents migrated three metres overnight. Campers blamed the moon.
lore.legendary: Kiri guards the last song of the ancient forest in its long beak. It sings only when no one watches; even the stars lower themselves to listen.

names.legendary: Macawra, Keeper of the Painted Dawn

lore.common: Yells 'GOOD MORNING' before the sun has decided to rise.
lore.uncommon: Cracks a nut with one bite, then laughs at the squirrels still using rocks.
lore.rare: Mimics the jungle ranger perfectly and sends entire tour groups looking for imaginary waterfalls.
lore.epic: Led a flying pirate fleet of macaws over the jungle canopy. Every stolen mango was divided among the parrots, and the monkeys demanded receipts.
lore.legendary: Macawra flew across an empty grey horizon and painted the first dawn with her tail feathers. Every sunrise since has owed her one bright colour.

names.legendary: Mantara, the Sea's Quiet Constellation

lore.common: Sails past divers like a gigantic underwater blanket that has somewhere important to be.
lore.uncommon: Waits at the reef's cleaning station with perfect manners while little fish tidy its gills.
lore.rare: Leaps from the water in a silent arc and returns with a splash big enough to rock the fishing boats.
lore.epic: Led a hundred mantas across the coral shelf, casting moving shadows over the reef like a cloud of enormous wings.
lore.legendary: Mantara carries the star patterns of the lost sea on her broad wings. When she turns beneath moonlight, sailors above glimpse constellations no longer visible in the sky.

names.legendary: Narwhalla, Herald of the Crystal Seas

lore.common: Pokes its spiral tusk through an ice hole and startles the seals having breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Slips beneath the pack ice with a long ivory spear pointing the way.
lore.rare: Senses changes in the water through its tusk and finds secret paths in the frozen sea.
lore.epic: Challenged an iceberg maze to a tournament and carved perfect gateways through the ice. The polar bears named it the winter champion.
lore.legendary: Narwhalla carried the first northern star reflected in the spiral of its tusk. Sailors lost beneath the aurora still follow the pale gleam to open water.

names.legendary: Matriarch Orcadia of the Deep Choir

lore.common: Pokes its head out of the water to see who has brought sandwiches on the boat.
lore.uncommon: Teaches its pod an inside joke in squeaks. Other families hear only extremely rude whistles.
lore.rare: Sends a perfect wave beneath an ice floe, flipping the lunch straight into the sea.
lore.epic: Conducted a pod of fifty in a midnight hunt so precisely that the waves formed a moving black-and-white crown. Even the lighthouse went quiet.
lore.legendary: Orcadia carried the songs of nine generations across the ocean. When an orphaned calf called into the dark, she answered in its grandmother's forgotten dialect.

names.legendary: Struthia, Runner Beyond the Horizon

lore.common: Stares at its own enormous egg as if surprised every time it sees it.
lore.uncommon: Carries its dignity on two ridiculous legs and loses both at corners.
lore.rare: Kicks a dust cloud so high that chasing predators start coughing politely.
lore.epic: Outran the safari convoy, leapt over the finish line and ate the winner's bouquet before the engines stopped.
lore.legendary: Struthia raced the east wind across a desert of burning sand and reached the oasis first. Ever since, the wind gives her a ten-minute head start.

names.legendary: Queen Ringara of the City Canopy

lore.common: Complains loudly about the weather from the warmest branch in the park.
lore.uncommon: Raids bird feeders with a gang that has matching green jackets.
lore.rare: Mimics the sound of a bicycle bell to clear a path through busy park trees.
lore.epic: Led a flock so vast across the city that every roof turned green. The pigeons filed a formal complaint about rent.
lore.legendary: Queen Ringara founded a colony in a foreign winter, keeping her flock warm with hidden rooftop gardens. Each generation returns to the same chimney to learn her first song.

names.legendary: Captain Pollyphrase of the Seven Seas

lore.common: Screams hello at a closed door until someone answers, then asks for a biscuit.
lore.uncommon: Learns the dog's bark so perfectly that the dog apologises for noises it never made.
lore.rare: Repeats a secret overheard in the kitchen at exactly the worst possible dinner party.
lore.epic: Took over the town radio station and interviewed every animal in the zoo. The flamingo refused to discuss its private life.
lore.legendary: Captain Pollyphrase memorised the final words of a lost pirate captain and carried them across seven oceans. When the treasure was found, he spent his share on a very large cracker.

names.legendary: Pavonius, Lord of the Emerald Court

lore.common: Spreads its fan in front of every visitor, then screams when nobody compliments it.
lore.uncommon: Uses shop windows as mirrors and refuses to walk past an unattractive reflection.
lore.rare: Each eye on its tail watches a different corner of the garden. The foxes have stopped visiting.
lore.epic: Opened its tail during the king's parade and blocked the royal procession with a glittering wall of feathers. The crowd cheered louder than for the king.
lore.legendary: Pavonius carried the colours of a vanished rainbow in his tail and scattered them across a grey kingdom. Flowers bloomed where each feather fell, and the sky remembered how to shine.

names.legendary: Pelicandra, Keeper of the Silver Shoal

lore.common: Scoops up a bucket of water and then remembers it only wanted one fish.
lore.uncommon: Carries more snacks in its throat pouch than the whole beach picnic has packed.
lore.rare: Catches a leaping fish without losing the shell collection already stored in its beak.
lore.epic: Led a flotilla of pelicans through the harbour, each carrying a fisherman's lost hat in its pouch. The coastguard has offered them uniforms.
lore.legendary: Pelicandra sheltered the last silver shoal in her enormous pouch while a dark tide swept the coast. When the sea cleared, she released the fish beneath the morning sun, and the bay glittered again.

names.legendary: Lord Phasian of the Painted Fields

lore.common: Dashes out of the hedge precisely when a cyclist has stopped admiring the view.
lore.uncommon: Preens its shining copper feathers in puddles and chases away its own reflection.
lore.rare: Bursts from cover with a racket loud enough to make the village rooster question its career.
lore.epic: Led a hundred dazzling pheasants through the harvest parade. Every scarecrow bowed as the birds stole their hats.
lore.legendary: Lord Phasian wore feathers so brilliant that the first sunrise tried to borrow them. He refused, and the eastern sky has blushed red ever since.

names.legendary: Tetrodon, Warden of the Coral Moon

lore.common: Inflates when startled and gets wedged in a crack it fitted through five seconds earlier.
lore.uncommon: Swells into a spiky beach ball and insists the other fish were playing volleyball.
lore.rare: Blows itself up so quickly that a hungry shark ricochets backwards into a coral hedge.
lore.epic: Inflated beneath a pirate ship until it lifted the hull clear of the waves. The pirates still believe they sailed over an island.
lore.legendary: Tetrodon guards the coral moon, a white pearl larger than any reef. His thousand spines glow whenever danger approaches the sleeping sea.

names.legendary: Pufaria, Navigator of the Far Shoals

lore.common: Trips over its own feet and blames the slippery cliff.
lore.uncommon: Carries a ridiculous number of fish in its beak while still trying to greet the neighbours.
lore.rare: Dives through foaming surf and emerges with a perfect row of silver fish like medals.
lore.epic: Launched a thousand puffins from the cliff in perfect formation. The fishing fleet mistook the swarm for a new navy.
lore.legendary: Pufaria leads lost ships away from hidden rocks by flashing her colourful beak across the cliffs. The lighthouse keeper has been made her assistant.

names.legendary: Quailora, Captain of the Hidden Flock

lore.common: Bobs its little head feather whenever a crumb lands nearby.
lore.uncommon: Hides its entire family in grass too short to conceal a mouse.
lore.rare: Whistles in several directions at once, drawing predators away from the nest.
lore.epic: Led a covey through the harvest fields in a blur of tiny marching feathers. The combine harvester politely surrendered its keys.
lore.legendary: Quailora marched a hundred quail beneath the nose of a sleeping dragon without a sound. The dragon woke to find its treasure lined with tiny eggs.

names.legendary: Corvax, Bearer of the Unspoken Oath

lore.common: Steals the silver spoon from the picnic, then leaves a pebble as payment.
lore.uncommon: Learns three human words and uses them exclusively to annoy the gardener.
lore.rare: Challenges travellers to riddles and steals their sandwiches while they think.
lore.epic: Held a secret midnight trial of every shiny object stolen from the castle. The crown was found guilty of excessive glitter.
lore.legendary: Corvax stole a promise from the king's lips and hid it inside a shiny pebble. The king spent seven winters learning how to say sorry to get it back.

names.legendary: Salmoria, Keeper of the Homeward River

lore.common: Queues at the mouth of the river with a thousand fish and refuses to admit it is lost.
lore.uncommon: Can smell its childhood stream from the ocean, but still asks the trout for directions.
lore.rare: Leaps a roaring waterfall so elegantly that the bears forget to catch it and simply applaud.
lore.epic: Led a silver river of salmon against the current, overrunning the fish ladder and shutting down the dam's visitor centre.
lore.legendary: Salmoria carries the memory of every stream she has ever swum in one shining scale. When rivers are forgotten, that scale glows until the salmon find their way home.

names.legendary: Scallopia, the Hundred-Eyed Pearl

lore.common: Claps its shell shut whenever a crab tells an unfunny joke.
lore.uncommon: Blinks a row of bright blue eyes along the shell and insists it is not staring.
lore.rare: Jets through the water by snapping its valves together, leaving the starfish breathless with envy.
lore.epic: Conducted a thousand scallops in an underwater percussion concert. The whales changed their migration route to hear the encore.
lore.legendary: Scallopia's hundred blue eyes once saw a pearl fall from the moon into the sea. Each shell she opens now holds a glimmer of that impossible night.

names.legendary: Spongella, the Sea's Patient Heart

lore.common: Looks like a rock until it squeezes seawater into the face of a passing crab.
lore.uncommon: Sucks up a whole rockpool's water and then apologises to the furious starfish.
lore.rare: Filters an astonishing cloud of muddy water, leaving a clear patch of sea around its own tiny reef.
lore.epic: Drank a whole tidal surge through its countless pores and squeezed it back into the bay after the fishermen were safely home.
lore.legendary: Spongella drank a century of muddy tides to reveal a lost underwater city. The city council offered her a cleaning contract; she requested a very long nap.

names.legendary: Gullivera, Tyrant of the Seafront

lore.common: Snatches the largest chip from a tourist and screams as though it has been robbed.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly which bin was filled with leftovers five minutes ago. The council has given up installing lids.
lore.rare: Can imitate a baby crying loudly enough to empty a seaside cafe, then walks in and steals the sandwiches.
lore.epic: Led every gull on the seafront in a perfectly timed raid. The ice cream sellers still whisper of the afternoon when the sky turned white.
lore.legendary: Gullivera crowned herself queen of every pier between two oceans. Her throne is built from stolen chips, and the lifeguards must request permission before opening their lunchboxes.

names.legendary: Hippocampa, Keeper of the Cradle Current

lore.common: Clings to the same piece of seaweed all day and insists it is a very busy schedule.
lore.uncommon: Carries a pouch full of babies and complains that the other seahorses never offer to babysit.
lore.rare: Changes colour to match the coral so perfectly that its own reflection loses track of it.
lore.epic: Led a miniature cavalry charge through the seagrass beds. The crabs surrendered to avoid being tickled by a thousand tiny snouts.
lore.legendary: Hippocampa holds the smallest ocean current in a pouch beside her heart. It carries lost seahorse babies home through tides far too strong for their tiny fins.

names.legendary: Sturnella, the Sky's Living Ink

lore.common: Copies a car alarm perfectly, then watches the owners run outside in their slippers.
lore.uncommon: Shows off iridescent feathers like it has just discovered a very expensive jacket.
lore.rare: Can repeat a hundred different sounds at once, producing a choir of alarm clocks that nobody knows how to silence.
lore.epic: Led a million birds into a colossal moving shape of a dragon above the capital. The dragon stole the mayor's thunder, literally.
lore.legendary: Sturnella writes patterns across the evening sky with a thousand wings. One autumn her flock spelled a warning the clouds had been trying to deliver for centuries.

names.legendary: Rayeza, Keeper of the Hidden Sands

lore.common: Buries itself in the sand and giggles when unsuspecting crabs trip over its fins.
lore.uncommon: Glides like a flying carpet over the seafloor, politely declining passengers.
lore.rare: Can send a ripple through the ocean floor without disturbing a single grain of sand around its hiding place.
lore.epic: Rose with a thousand rays from beneath the seabed, turning the entire lagoon into a living carpet of graceful wings.
lore.legendary: Rayeza once carried the reflection of the moon across the ocean on her broad back. Sailors say the silvery path on the water still follows where she swam.

names.legendary: Ciconara, Bearer of the Long Road

lore.common: Clacks its beak so loudly that all the neighbours check their letterboxes.
lore.uncommon: Builds a nest on the chimney and accidentally adopts the chimney sweep.
lore.rare: Rides warm air columns for days, carrying messages that nobody remembered to write.
lore.epic: Gathered a thousand migrating storks into an arrow across the sky, guiding every lost traveller through a spring storm.
lore.legendary: Ciconara returned to the same rooftop for a thousand springs, even after the village beneath it vanished. Eventually a new village grew around her nest.

names.legendary: Hirundelle, the Wing That Finds Home

lore.common: Swoops into the barn at full speed and laughs when the cows duck.
lore.uncommon: Builds its nest from stolen mud and charges the horses for roof repairs.
lore.rare: Catches mosquitoes mid-flight without losing a single feather from its forked tail.
lore.epic: Guided a thousand migrating swallows through a storm by tracing a silver ribbon across the clouds. The fishermen called it a road to summer.
lore.legendary: Hirundelle has crossed the same oceans for countless springs, returning to one little nest after wars erased every road beneath it. Its old barn always knows when to open the door.

names.legendary: Xiphiros, the Blade Before Steel

lore.common: Challenges fishing boats to duels and considers every retreat a victory.
lore.uncommon: Uses its swordlike bill to carve tiny initials into floating driftwood.
lore.rare: Slices a path through a shoal so swiftly that the fish separate into two perfectly neat queues.
lore.epic: Fenced with a storm-tossed ship's mast above the waves, cutting every loose sail free before the captain could blink.
lore.legendary: Xiphiros forged the first sword in the depths before humans learned metal. Old sailors claim every legendary blade still dreams of swimming home to him.

names.legendary: Ramphastara, the Living Rainbow Horn

lore.common: Throws berries into its enormous beak and misses every third one. It blames gravity.
lore.uncommon: Carries a fruit salad in its bill and refuses to share with parrots.
lore.rare: Uses its beak as a colourful signal that sends flocks of birds to distant flowering trees.
lore.epic: Tossed a thousand mangoes through the jungle canopy without dropping one, creating the first airborne fruit market. The monkeys immediately started stealing.
lore.legendary: Ramphastara wears the colours of a rainbow lost beneath the rainforest. At dawn she opens her immense beak to cool the sleeping forest, and seven invisible winds answer.

names.legendary: Specklefin, the Fish of the First Rain

lore.common: Inspects fishing flies and rejects every one with an insulting little splash.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps behind a pebble and wakes only when the tasty insects arrive.
lore.rare: Leaps against an icy waterfall so fiercely that the falling water seems to climb upwards with it.
lore.epic: Led a glittering shoal upstream through a roaring cascade, turning the entire waterfall silver for one glorious afternoon.
lore.legendary: Specklefin knows the river's secret source beneath a mountain of blue glass. Once each spring it swims upstream carrying a single living raindrop to awaken the thirsty valley.

names.legendary: Thunnara, the Silver Arrow of the Deep

lore.common: Races past its own lunch and has to swim back looking embarrassed.
lore.uncommon: Keeps its muscles warm and calls every shivering fish a lightweight.
lore.rare: Crosses vast stretches of open ocean without resting, leaving a ribbon of silver bubbles behind.
lore.epic: Led a school through a swirling undersea current and sliced the surface into a glittering spiral visible from the cliffs.
lore.legendary: Thunnara has followed the same secret highway across the oceans since before the oldest maps. Wherever her silver fins pass, lost migrating fish remember the road home.

names.legendary: Meleagrus, Emperor of Autumn Feathers

lore.common: Gobble-gobbles at the doorbell even after the visitor has gone home.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles its red neck so dramatically that the chickens request quieter neighbours.
lore.rare: Fans its enormous tail to hypnotise every farmyard admirer, then steals their corn.
lore.epic: Led a thousand turkeys through the county fair in a grand feathered parade, accidentally blocking the livestock auction for two days.
lore.legendary: Meleagrus guarded a mountain orchard where no winter harvest ever failed. His tail held the colours of every fallen leaf, and one magnificent gobble summoned the first autumn frost.

names.legendary: Vulturion, Steward of the Silent Plains

lore.common: Spreads its wings to dry them and demands applause from the meerkats.
lore.uncommon: Circles so gracefully that the hot-air balloons ask for lessons.
lore.rare: Spots abandoned picnic sandwiches from farther away than the nearest airport.
lore.epic: Swept across the savannah with a hundred companions and cleared the aftermath of a lion's feast before the hyenas had finished complaining.
lore.legendary: Promised the ancient plains that nothing fallen would be wasted. Every creature knows its shadow, though the living usually prefer to see it at a distance.

names.legendary: Rhincodon, the Star-Freckled Wanderer

lore.common: Opens its giant mouth and accidentally catches three startled sardines in a cloud of plankton.
lore.uncommon: Wears a constellation of pale spots on its back and acts as though the stars copied it.
lore.rare: Escorts lost divers through deep blue water while the little fish hide beneath its belly.
lore.epic: Carried a whole travelling reef of fish through the bay. From above, the school looked like an underwater city moving through the waves.
lore.legendary: Crosses warm oceans following the hidden blooming of plankton. Its starry skin holds a map older than human navigation, and patient divers sometimes glimpse new constellations on its back.

names.legendary: Picoria, the Heartbeat of the Oak

lore.common: Drums on the drainpipe at dawn because trees do not annoy enough people.
lore.uncommon: Taps a secret rhythm against every trunk and expects the squirrels to answer.
lore.rare: Finds hidden insects by listening to the faintest movement beneath three layers of bark.
lore.epic: Professor Peckquake transformed the entire forest into a percussion orchestra. The dawn chorus filed a noise complaint, then joined the encore.
lore.legendary: Picoria pecked a single hollow into the oldest oak and discovered the forest's forgotten heartbeat. Each spring she strikes the tree once, and the dormant branches remember to grow.
